Normal reference for R03 (normal training observations, not exhaustive process specifications):

questions: 1. Is there a visible deviation from the yellow forklift's position?
selection: first five accepted rules in frozen candidate order; no performance-based selection
limitations: Support/audit judgments are generated by the same frozen VLM, not independent human annotation. Sparse frames may miss changes.
